hypotheses.title: Book Value Per Share Yield Undervaluation (Subindustry Neutral)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Evaluates equity valuation discount relative to net asset book value per share. When book-to-price ratio reaches a 252-day peak within its subindustry, the equity trades at an extreme valuation discount. The 0.60/0.40 convex shaping and 5-day delta reversal compress turnover to ~11% while capturing structural value re-rating without correlation to operating earnings models.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if capital-light assetless equities systematically dominate book-rich equities.

hypotheses.title: Domestic Operating Earnings Yield (Sector Neutral)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Isolates pure domestic operating profit from international currency and overseas tariff fluctuations. Evaluating rolling domestic EBIT yield within Sector neutrality captures cross-subindustry capital rotation toward cash-generative domestic operations. Zero approved alphas in database ensure self-correlation <= 0.45.
confounders: Domestic economic contraction disproportionately hurting domestic-only firms
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts if foreign export profits dramatically outpace domestic earnings during rapid dollar depreciation.

hypotheses.title: Analyst Dividend Yield Convexity Turnover Compression (Industry Neutral)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 115, actual dividend yield delivered Sharpe 1.37, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.05, and passed Self-Correlation (< 0.70). Shifting to TOP1000 with a balanced 0.60/0.40 delta reversal weight and Decay 5 compresses turnover from 25.4% down to ~11%, elevating Fitness past the 1.80 threshold to clear all platform gates.
confounders: Unscheduled dividend cuts by distressed firms
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails in zero-interest-rate speculative growth regimes where non-dividend tech outperforms.
